# iMosaicArt - Entity & Product Summary

## Brand Overview
iMosaicArt is a premium US-based provider of handcrafted stone and glass mosaic art. We specialize in custom-made mosaic portraits, wall decor, and architectural tile installations for residential, commercial, and public spaces.

## Core Offerings
- Custom Mosaics: Bespoke designs based on client photos, branding, or artistic visions.
- Handmade Materials: High-grade natural stone, marble, and hand-cut glass.
- Art Styles: Traditional Roman techniques, modern geometric designs, portraits, and floral motifs.
- Applications: Interior wall art, floor inlays, backsplash tiles, and durable outdoor installations.

## Key Differentiators (USPs)
- Craftsmanship: Fusion of traditional hand-cutting techniques with modern design precision.
- Durability: Pieces are engineered for longevity and environmental resistance.
- Global Logistics: Headquartered in New York with Free Worldwide Shipping.
- Collaborative Process: Direct artist-to-client consultation on color, texture, and layout.

## Portfolio & Projects
- **Project Gallery:** https://www.imosaicart.com/pages/portfolio-mosaics
- **Capabilities:** Custom marble portraits, large-scale commercial installations, and bespoke residential tile art.
- **Custom Work Showcase:** Visual proof of craftsmanship in stone and glass for offices and homes.
